title: Multi-Year Name Rate for Added Names
content:
**Rate card note — multi-year name rate for names added to SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions**

The yearly price of a name added to an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription follows the multi-year name rate of the term line the name is billed into:

- where that line covers **three years**, the yearly price is multiplied by the product's 3-year price per year divided by its 1-year price;
- where it covers **two years**, the yearly price is multiplied by the product's 2-year price per year divided by its 1-year price;
- otherwise (a line of one year) the yearly price is not multiplied.

The term line the name is billed into is the subscription's purchase, renewal or auto-renew charge line whose period ends on the subscription end date, the latest by charge date where several do. A renewal line that was later refunded no longer carries the term: its refund has brought the subscription end date back to that line's period start. The years a line covers are the years shown on that billing line.

## Price figures the rate reads

| Product | 1-year price | 2-year price per year | 3-year price per year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 19.99 | 17.99 | 15.99 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 49.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 89.99 | 80.99 | 71.99 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 69.99 | 62.99 | 55.99 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 219.99 | 197.99 | 175.99 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 169.99 | 152.99 | 135.99 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 279.99 | 251.99 | 223.99 |

## Rate by the term line

| Years on the term line | Multiplier of the added name's yearly price |
|---|---|
| 3 | 3-year price per year divided by 1-year price |
| 2 | 2-year price per year divided by 1-year price |
| 1 | none |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A hypothetical Harborline EV Multi-Domain subscription whose term line is a 3-year auto-renew line: an added name's yearly price of 59.99 is multiplied by 223.99 divided by 279.99, giving about 47.992.
- A hypothetical Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription whose term line is its 2-year purchase line: a yearly price of 14.99 is multiplied by 44.99 divided by 49.99, giving about 13.491.
- The same subscription after a 1-year renewal whose line now ends on the subscription end date: the yearly price is not multiplied.
